The world of New Media and Immersive Tech
represents the continuing innovation of mass
communication and the technologies that enable it.
Companies that operate in this industry fall under
the sectors of online publishing, social networks,
films and TV, photography, videography and video
content, virtual reality, video games, and marketing
and advertising technology
In collaboration with Huckletree, we explore the UK’s
New Media and Immersive Tech industry, including
groundbreaking Extended Reality technology and
the companies developing the Future of Gaming.
